text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, heading to the track, I saw Air Messiah
running with an intensity far beyond mere practice.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *whew*... Not done yet...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah?
text_block_list.text: Yes, truly. Especially the way she eases off in the corners, followed by her acceleration into the final stretch—simply flawless.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah?
text_block_list.text:
This self-directed training certainly
reflects a sharp focus on the real race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Suddenly, a strange feeling comes over me.
Air Messiah is currently in the middle of a run.
Yet the one speaking to me right now is also Air Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Mother! How was my running?

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text: Hello. I am Air Messiah's mother.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ? Um... is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, I see. People have always said
that my mother and I are very much alike.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
My mother happened to have business over here today,
so I had her watch my training.

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. I could have introduced myself right away,
but your reaction was simply too amusing.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Mother, regarding my run just now,
how did it look to you?

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
That was a magnificent run.
Trainer said so as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Wow, really?!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah, !

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Fufu, fufufu! Today is the absolute best day ever!

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Even so, you mustn't let your guard down.
You have to stay diligent and keep improving.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Using this joy as fuel, I shall forge ahead!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes, she is my proud mother, after all!

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It feels a little embarrassing in public...
Still, you're right. I'm so proud of you, Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Mother...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I will live up to your expectations.
Please keep your eyes on me!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Well then, I shall run one more time just to be sure!

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm watching, Messiah.
Let's get you thoroughly polished up.
